versions.name: Change 1
versions.change: Blind spec, 10 edits: sign-in label and test hooks renamed; Pay and Request hooks, placeholders and button row changed; top bar reordered; drawer labels renamed; bank-account Create button moved; confirmation dialogs added for deleting a bank account and rejecting a request.

versions.name: Change 2
versions.change: Blind spec on top of change 1, 9 edits: Delete becomes Remove; Pay and Request become a toggle plus Continue; a review dialog before sending; sign-in form regrouped; drawer reordered with a sign-out confirmation; sign-up hook and label renamed; settings fields get labels; notification Dismiss moved.

scenarios.title: Valid credentials open the authenticated home
scenarios.bug: Return the correct-credentials submission to the signed-out sign-in view without an error message.

scenarios.title: Sign-out ends the authenticated session
scenarios.bug: After successful server logout, leave the browser on the authenticated home route, showing a stale home shell until reload. End the session and keep authorization checks in force.

scenarios.title: A changed first name is retained
scenarios.bug: Preserve the typed first name in the current form after Save while discarding the first-name update, so the displayed account name retains the previous value.

scenarios.title: An invalid email cannot be saved
scenarios.bug: Accept the scenario's malformed input in the settings form, exposing no email-format error after leaving the Email field.

scenarios.title: A new bank account is retained
scenarios.bug: Keep Create and Save functional, acknowledge submission and return to the list without storing the new account.

scenarios.title: An existing bank account is soft deleted
scenarios.bug: Keep the Delete flow actionable and acknowledge completion without marking the record deleted.

scenarios.title: A payment records the requested amount and recipient
scenarios.bug: Apply the reported 100-fold scale error to the paid amount shown in the transaction row.

scenarios.title: A request records the requested amount and recipient
scenarios.bug: Keep the normal request confirmation and show $0.00 for the requested amount in the personal feed row.

scenarios.title: Liking a transaction is retained exactly once
scenarios.bug: Update the displayed count and button state on Like while dropping the write, so reload restores the pre-click state.

scenarios.title: A comment is retained exactly once
scenarios.bug: Fail the comment service call so the submitted text never appears in the thread.

scenarios.title: Mine opens the personal feed
scenarios.bug: Omit the signed-in user's transactions from the personal feed response while retaining their records.

scenarios.title: Friends opens the contacts feed
scenarios.bug: Return an empty contacts feed for a user who has contact transactions.

scenarios.title: Dismissing a notification removes it from the list
scenarios.bug: Accept the Dismiss click and keep the selected row in the notifications list.

scenarios.title: A newly signed-up user can sign in and is greeted by onboarding
scenarios.bug: Keep registration and first sign-in working and route to home without opening the onboarding dialog.

scenarios.title: Sign up rejects a password confirmation that does not match
scenarios.bug: Suppress the inline confirmation mismatch message after blur. Keep submission validation in place.

scenarios.title: Changing the phone number persists after reload
scenarios.bug: Acknowledge the phone edit successfully and retain the old phone value in storage so reload restores it.

scenarios.title: Searching by first name brings the matching person to the top
scenarios.bug: Leave the initial people list intact, then omit first-name matches from the filtered results.

scenarios.title: Accepting a request turns it into a charge
scenarios.bug: Complete acceptance while leaving the detail title on the pre-acceptance Requested wording.

scenarios.title: Rejecting a request closes it without charging
scenarios.bug: Complete the rejection click, then restore the pending presentation so the same request again shows Accept and Reject.

scenarios.title: Filtering the Mine feed to amounts between $10 and $20
scenarios.bug: Keep the chosen chip and lower bound intact, but apply the upper bound in the wrong amount units so larger transactions remain visible.
